text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
You're full of motivation, Pandora-chan.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yep, totally♡ Because this summer,
I'm gonna be reborn!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
This year, I'm not going to festivals, test of courage, or watermelon splitting.
I've totally, seriously steeled my resolve, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What's up?
What what what what?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, you know, there's talk among
my classmates about throwing a curry party—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I felt a little lonely. ...Still,
if that's the reason, it can't be helped.
Do your best with your training!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to eat curry and have fun with everyone~!
Waaaah~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, oh! Then, then look...! After the Shuka Sho is over, let's do it one more time! Right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hey, everyone! Shouldn't we do that?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—amidst such resolve and tears!
This year's summer training camp had officially begun!
